verifiedInvariants: Model revision indexes belong to one Studio; multi-key publication installs every version before notifying a subscription once.
Selector equality retains the selected snapshot and prevents renders for equal outputs, including prop, key and owner changes.
Explicit field selectors rebind actual model dependencies and release subscriptions when unused or retired.
Project catalogs, dependencies, arena layout, inspector titles, header permissions and custom function schemas use their actual finite inputs.
Synchronous command queries and registration-dependent caches invalidate from current model writes and real registry revisions.
Retired model references cannot reconnect to a replacement owner; model-backed dialogs are cleared on owner exit.
Unchanged UI commands retain store snapshots; frame-delayed subscriptions read current values and cancel old scheduled notifications.
Immediate selector callbacks observe writes performed inside the callback.
Memo boundaries preserve parent-prop bailout behavior, including forwardRef wrappers.
Test notification cleanup does not create late React roots after the jsdom environment is destroyed.

performanceEvidence.method: Deterministic notification, computation and React render counters with real model ownership, plus full Studio regression
covered: Equal selected output does not render
Unrelated model fields do not recompute finite projections
Repeated unchanged UI commands do not publish
